toast.keyTakenFix: Another app has it. Change it in Settings
toast.notSaved.starting: Instant replay is starting, try again in a moment
toast.notSaved.write: The file could not be written to the clips folder
toast.notSaved.behind: Recording fell behind the game: the graphics card is busy
fix.closeRecorders: Close other recorders or restart Kairos
bar.savedOnly: Saved. Applies when the engine starts
status.folderFallback: The clips folder is unavailable, so clips go to {0}
status.captureNoApp: No app is chosen in Capture, so Kairos records the full screen
status.captureGone: The chosen app isn't open, so Kairos records the full screen
status.antiCheat: Riot Vanguard is running, so Games mode records the full screen
status.nvidiaDriver: The NVIDIA driver is too old for its encoder: update it (nvidia.com/drivers), then restart the PC
status.diskReplayFailed: The disk could not be used, so the replay is in RAM
status.nvidiaRestart: The NVIDIA driver was updated: restart the PC so Kairos can use its encoder
status.reportTip: The logs and settings in a zip on your Desktop, to send us
status.encoderFallback: Recording with {0}: the {1} encoder could not start
status.relief: A game took the graphics card, so Kairos records lighter (60 fps, 1080p at most) to keep clips smooth
status.reliefCpu: A game took the graphics card, so Kairos records on the CPU (1080p, 30 fps) to keep clips smooth
status.behind: Recording can't keep up with the game: cap the game's frame rate below your screen's
status.audioDevice: System sound could not be captured from {0}: pick it by name in Audio, or switch the headset to Stereo
capture.freshTip: The next clip never repeats the one just saved.
capture.diskHdd: A hard disk (HDD) may slow a game kept on it
capture.appsTip: The one in front is recorded. Up to 5.
capture.appsFrame: On Windows 10, Windows draws a yellow frame around the recorded app. It isn't in the clip; Games has none.
capture.fallback: Show the screen when no game runs
capture.cameraTip: Your webcam or phone over the recording
capture.layoutRestart: Changing the layout restarts the replay.
capture.cameraPlaceTip: Drag the camera on the picture
capture.cameraFile: Also save the camera on its own
quality.autoTip: Kairos picks the encoder, size, rate and quality for your PC
quality.autoNoAv1: This card has no AV1 encoder.
quality.autoCpu: No graphics encoder works here, so the CPU records (lighter).
quality.res4k: On this 4K screen, 1440p keeps clips smaller; Native keeps every pixel.
quality.fpsAboveScreen: Your screen shows {0} frames a second: more are never seen
quality.encoderPresetTip: Slower is sharper, faster is lighter. Games aren’t affected
quality.cpuOnly: No GPU encoder, so recording is limited to 1080p at 30 fps
quality.av1Note: Windows needs the free AV1 extension to play your clips
audio.sourceOnly: Only the app or game sound
audio.layoutSeparateTip: Recommended: each sound on its own track
audio.layoutTogetherTip: System sound and microphone, as before
audio.separateNeedsWindows: Separate sources need Windows 10 version 2004 or newer: on this Windows all of the PC’s sound is recorded together.
audio.virtualChatPick: {0} carries only its own sound, not the game's. Pick {1}, or use separate sources.
audio.virtualChat: {0} carries only its own sound, not the game's. Use separate sources: the game is recorded from the game itself.
audio.mixPartPick: {0} carries only part of your sound: {1} splits it. Pick {2}, where {1} plays all of it, or use separate sources.
audio.mixPart: {0} carries only part of your sound: {1} splits it. Pick the headphones or speakers you listen on, where {1} plays all of it, or use separate sources.
audio.mixSplit: {0} carries only part of your sound: {1} splits it, and no playback device has all of it. Use separate sources: each app is recorded from itself.
audio.micWholeMixPick: {0} is {1}'s whole mix (the game, chat, music and your voice): the rest would be recorded twice, and Smart Save would hear it all. Pick {2} for your voice.
audio.micWholeMix: {0} is {1}'s whole mix (the game, chat, music and your voice): the rest would be recorded twice, and Smart Save would hear it all. Pick the device with your voice alone.
audio.noTrackLeft: All six tracks are used: this source shares the last one
hotkeys.takenBox: Used by another app, pick another
hotkeys.hint: Click, then press the keys. Backspace clears.
general.captionsNone: Not downloaded. The editor asks before downloading it
accounts.subtitle: Where Kairos posts. Sign-ins stay on this PC.
accounts.signInHint: Sign in on the page. This window closes by itself once you are in.
accounts.unavailable: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (part of Windows 11).
voice.enable: Save clips and screenshots with your voice
voice.enableTip: Start with your phrase to save a clip. Offline, any language
voice.noneTip: Pick two distinct words, like “Kairos, clip it”.
voice.err.short: Too short, say the whole phrase
voice.err.long: Too long, keep it under 2.5 seconds
voice.err.different: That didn’t sound like the first one, say it the same way
voice.err.notAlike: One time sounded different, say it again the same way
voice.err.noMic: Turn Smart Save on and press Save first
voice.err.files: Smart Save files are missing, reinstall Kairos
voice.err.engine: Kairos isn’t running, start it from Status
voice.sensitivityTip: Strict: fewer false saves. Easy: catches rushed words
voice.hint: New: save clips with your voice
voice.hintTip: Say a phrase you choose instead of pressing a hotkey.
general.cloudTip: New clips go to its Kairos folder; saved ones stay
general.cloudNone: Install OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox and sign in; its button shows here
general.cloudOff: {0} isn't running, so clips won't upload
general.freeLocalTip: Kept online only once uploaded, to save disk space
general.cloudStreams: Google Drive keeps the clips online by itself.
saving.limitTip: Oldest Kairos clips go to the Recycle Bin; other files stay
clips.title: Library
clips.empty: No clips yet. Press {0} while you play.
clips.confirmForever: Permanently delete {0}? This cannot be undone.
editor.newCopyTip: The original stays as it is
editor.replaceTip: The original goes to the Recycle Bin
editor.discard.title: Leave without saving?
editor.discard.body: The changes you made will be lost.
editor.captionsTip: Writes what's said as timed text you can edit
editor.page.caption: Caption
editor.hint.clip: Click an item to edit it alone; a row’s name picks the row
editor.hint.part: Split with S; each part has its own speed and sound
editor.hint.allTexts: All texts at once: click "Text" in the timeline.
editor.reset.title: Reset the clip?
editor.reset.body: Every edit is removed; Ctrl+Z brings them back.
editor.recaption.title: Make the captions again?
editor.recaption.body: New captions replace the current ones; your texts stay.
editor.hint.draw: Each line keeps its colour; pick one to change it
editor.hint.blur: Move the box on the picture, or resize it from a corner.
editor.hint.mixed: The colour changes all of them. Delete removes them.
editor.zoomTip: Zoom into an area of the chosen parts
editor.hint.zoom: Draw the area to zoom to on the picture
editor.intro.what: Writes what you say as timed captions, in any language.
editor.intro.where: Runs on this PC and hears your voice, not the game.
editor.intro.stays: Stays on this PC; remove it in Settings › General
keys.cutBefore: Cut from the part's start to here
keys.cutAfter: Cut from here to the part's end
voice.shotNoneTip: A second phrase for screenshots, like “snap that”
voice.err.tooClose: That sounds too much like your other phrase. Pick a different one.
share.pictureUnreadable: The screenshot could not be read. It may have been moved or deleted.
clips.emptyShots: No screenshots yet. Press {0} to take one.
share.title: Share clip
share.verticalTip: Drag the frame on the picture to choose what stays in view.
share.caption: Caption and hashtags
share.copyTip: Copies the cut at the size you pick; paste it anywhere
share.copyTooLong: Only the last {0} s fit in {1}.
share.previewVolume: Preview volume (the clip itself is not changed)
share.hint.copy: The file is on the clipboard. Paste it anywhere with Ctrl+V.
share.pub.login: Sign in in the window that opened. Only once; then it carries on by itself.
share.pub.caption: Writing the caption…
share.pub.manual: Couldn't finish by itself. Finish the post in the window that opened; the video and caption are there.
share.posted.hint: It's out. Open it with the button.
share.posted.tiktok: Sent to TikTok; it can take a few minutes to show on your profile.
update.waitingGame: Updates when you leave the game
update.failed: The update could not be downloaded
toast.updateImportantDetail: Installs itself the next time Kairos starts
toast.updatedDetail: Open Kairos to see what's new
update.nextStart: Not now? It installs itself the next time Kairos starts, never during a recording.
